about_the_game:
Welcome to Cafe Bits! You have taken the first steps towards becoming a world class part-time barista, you have to pay your bills and tuition somehow. However, you find out that the Cafe is host to FOUR handsome boys vying to be your boyfriend, lovey-dovey, forever-after. But...which one won't leave you with a heart broken and aching?

MEET THE LOVERS ENTWINED:

  • You

You are the newest barista at Cafe Bits, a simple art student trying her best to make it on her own and make ends meet. And meet they do, you and lovely boys that is! With a flair for the romantic and a soul desperate for a mate, can you brew a precious love story? Or will he leave a bitter taste in your mouth?

  • Axel

Cafe Bits' resident pâtissièr. Fancy, charming, and he knows it. While some men will try hard to become a heartthrob Casanova, he makes it look effortless. Let this lover boy know that, of all the pastry kitchens in the world, you'd gladly walk into his. Let's just hope you're the only one he's got an eye on.

  • Kit

A childhood friend bringing back floods of nostalgia and, perhaps, undeclared feelings? Kit has always been a little wimpy kid at the best of times. But, this charismatic young man making you fall head over heels is unmistakably him. You never would've guessed he would grow up this handsome! Maybe it's always meant to be. He'd certainly agree.

  • Jay

Cafe Bits' OTHER barista. And boy, you certainly figure out quickly how he's been there for so long. Straight to the point. Precise. Cold. The thing is... maybe there's more to him? You see glimpses of a loving heart behind the wall of ice, waiting to be melted away. Would you be the one to do it, if it's there at all?

  • Timmy

This fellow art student has a way with drawings, just not with words. He expresses himself very clearly, though. His thumbs twiddle if he's nervous, he stutters to think of the right things to say, and he's got the CUTEST blush you've ever seen! Maybe, he just needs someone to hold his hands when he's nervous? There's no way this cute creature would demand too much from you.

GAMEPLAY & FEATURES (The following is a list of features present in this demo, and is not representative of the game in its full version):

  • Navigate the world of budding romance as you try to not forget your responsibilities as a barista.

  • Learn more about your love interests by interacting and bonding with them.

  • Serve each customer their drinkable pick-me-up and try to keep your job.

  • Collect CGs and blush while reliving your memories with the boys.

  • Experience different romances with each of the 4 love interests.
